title: Appointed as Assistant
original: Let's see what goodies the Doctor hides in this drawer.

title: Talk 1
original: I'm probably only about as big as one of Papa's legs right now. But one day, I'm gonna be as big as him, and then I'll trample all over the bad guys! Graaagh!

title: Talk 2
original: I'm really, really sorry! I won't run in the hallways ever again!

title: Talk 3
original: Fighting is super easy. I point my shield one way, and nobody can beat me. Huh? What if they get behind me? Ohyeaah... I never thought of that!

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: Gavial? Never heard of her. She's tough? She's famous in Sargon? Okay, whatever. I'll see for myself how tough she is.

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: Oh, you're talking about Gavial? I'm Gavial's number one fan. See, she even signed my shield for me. That's her autograph! I think pretty much nobody could take down Gavial, besides Papa.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: Doctor, shhh, tell me the truth. Kay says Vulcan can hammer straight through the floor, can she? No? Phew... Hehe. I knew it. That means my Papa is definitely stronger. He could bust down a Rhodes smoke stack with one punch.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: Do I really have to write it in the notebook...? Fine... 'I knocked over Lancet-2 today. I won't do it again.'

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: This is my shield. It'll be one of my greaves someday, or maybe a pauldron. Then as long as I'm standing behind you, hehe, nobody'll ever bully you.

title: Idle
original: Doctor, wake up! Someone's here to see you.

title: Onboard
original: You're the boss of this training camp? And they call you the Doctor? Hrmmmm... But you don't look strong... Whatever. I'm Bubble. I may be the weakest in my tribe right now, but you're gonna train me until I'm the second strongest.

title: Watching Battle Record
original: Fight! Fight! Fiiiiiight! What, why'd they stop. Is it over?

title: Promotion 1
original: A reward for my training? Great! I can't eat it? Grrr...

title: Promotion 2
original: I think I got a good chance of beating Kay now! Okay, lemme at her. Doctor, you can come watch!

title: Added to Squad
original: Be good? I'll try.

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: I'll count down and we charge on one, okay?

title: Depart
original: Chaaarge!

title: Begin Operation
original: Waaar!

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: I got this.

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: Haha!

title: Deployment 1
original: Get the bad guys!

title: Deployment 2
original: Shield up!

title: In Battle 1
original: Traaaaaample!

title: In Battle 2
original: Baaaaash!

title: In Battle 3
original: Spike striiiike!

title: In Battle 4
original: Bam!

title: 4-star Result
original: Doctor, if you got your body as strong as your brain, you could be an awesome warrior like my Papa!

title: 3-star Result
original: What did I tell you? I'm super strong.

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: Huh? Some of them got away? Did I let them through?

title: Operation Failure
original: We can't beat them! Whatdowedo?! Whatdowedo?!

title: Assigned to Facility
original: I need a way, waaay bigger room. How can anyone live in a little place like this?

title: Tap
original: Hey, that tickles.

title: Trust Tap
original: Doctor, let's play hide-and-seek!

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: New Year's blessing
original: It's New Year's! We got the day off! No homework! That means it's time to challenge Kay! Doctor, you can't just sit there all day. Why don't you come wrestle with us? It'll be fun!

title: Greeting
original: Doctor!

title: Birthday
original: Happy birthday, Doctor! Oh, this means you've grown a whole extra year! When am I gonna get as big as you?

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: I have to train hard at Rhodes Island! First, I'm gonna get tougher than Kay, then I'll beat Gavial, until I finally outdo Vulcan! Then I can go back home and be a warrior as great as Papa...! Doctor, are you gonna miss me when I'm gone?
